backend/main.mo: Includes MixinStorage to enable blob storage functionality in the backend actor.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing two frontend asset and image update tasks with associated files and metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file providing short summaries for multiple frontend components and styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that loads the React app and sets favicon and metadata.
frontend/src/.well-known/ic-domains: Specifies the allowed domain shivaritaglobal.com for IC verification.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Initializes and provides the TanStack Router instance for the app.
frontend/src/components/AboutSection.tsx: Renders the About section with company overview, mission, expertise, and feature highlights.
Displays service categories and visa type links leading to Product Offerings subsections.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Implements contact form with validation, email/WhatsApp submission, and confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/components/CountrySlideshow: Interactive country slideshow with autoplay, navigation controls, and click-through to contact page.
frontend/src/components/DisclaimerSectio: Renders a multi-section disclaimer with icons covering visa approval, information accuracy, legal changes, and related notices.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Creates a site footer with company info, navigation links, social links, and dynamic year display.
frontend/src/components/GDPRSection.tsx: Displays GDPR compliance details, principles, and explanations using styled cards and icons.
frontend/src/components/GlobeSection.tsx: Empty placeholder component with no implementation.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Implements a responsive, auto-hiding header with navigation links, scroll behavior, and mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Shows the main homepage hero with heading, CTAs, feature stats, and gradient visuals.
frontend/src/components/InteractiveGlobe: Empty placeholder component with no implementation.
frontend/src/components/MapSection.tsx: Renders a world map section with a clickable overlay leading to the contact page.
Large component rendering tabbed product offerings with deep-link handling and accordion sections for different visa categories.
frontend/src/components/WhyChooseUs.tsx: Displays company USPs, ancillary services, and a detailed promise section using styled cards and icons.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity, initializing access control and refetching dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity provider and hook for authentication, identity loading, login, and logout logic.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Stub hook returning no backend queries for this static site.
frontend/src/ic-assets.json: Defines asset rules for ICP deployment, matching the .well-known directory.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind setup defining light/dark theme variables and base styles including gradients and utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point setting up React, query client, identity provider, and rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Home page composing hero, map, slideshow, and category sections.
frontend/src/routeTree.tsx: Defines application routes using TanStack Router with a shared layout and page mappings.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities to read URL parameters (including hash-based), store and retrieve them in sessionStorage, and clear them from the URL or storage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, container settings, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Defines the project's metadata, existing features, and a pending request related to updating a comparison chart image.
